title: Rabbah of Kuvei

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Kiddushin 8a](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.8a.11): Mar bar Rav Ashi bought a scarf worth ten for thirteen from the mother of Rabbah of Kuvei.[^1][^2]

notes.text: [Heilprin’s headword](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3124&lang=en) and the vocalized Bavli give Rava of Kuvei. Hyman gives Rabbah, as does the English Davidson rendering of the passage.
Mar bar Rav Ashi pays thirteen for a scarf worth ten, buying it from the sage’s mother.
